title: All yours, but touch nothing
odia:
ଘର ଦୁଆର ସବୁ ତୋର
କାହିଁରେ ନଦେବୁ ହାତ।
literal_meaning: The house and doorway are all yours; do not lay a hand on anything.
meaning_odia: ଘର ଦୁଆର ସବୁ ତୋର ବୋଲି କହି, ପୁଣି କୌଣସି ଜିନିଷରେ ହାତ ଦେବାକୁ ମନା କରାଯାଉଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଏହି ବିରୋଧ କଥାରେ ଅଧିକାର ବା ଆଦର ଦେଖାଇ ବାସ୍ତବରେ ବ୍ୟବହାରର ସୁଯୋଗ ନଦେବାକୁ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରେ।
explanation: The first line appears to give everything; the second prevents even a touch. Our editorial reading hears hollow generosity or authority granted only in words. The contradiction makes the promise collapse as soon as the listener tries to imagine using it.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone is told a shared room is theirs to use, but every proposed use is then forbidden. They quote the saying to describe permission that exists only in words.
cultural_context: ସବୁ makes the offer sweeping, and କାହିଁରେ makes the restriction equally sweeping. The ordinary act of putting out a hand tests the claim of belonging: the person addressed may be told everything is theirs but cannot act on that assurance.

witnesses.locator: Page15, fifth item beginning ଘର ଦୁଆର ସବୁ ତୋର.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; both lines retained without repair. Apparent generosity versus withheld access is an editorial interpretation of the explicit contradiction.

graphic.alt: A woman raises one hand to stop a visitor from approaching a chair, desk and cupboard.
graphic.caption: An imagined welcome becomes a prohibition on using what is offered.

odia_summary: କଥାରେ ସବୁ ଦେଇ ବାସ୍ତବରେ କିଛି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବାକୁ ନଦେବା।
english_summary: An offer of everything undermined by a prohibition on using any of it.
